custody_rule: Select a signing service using the tenant registry and canonical issuer tuple. If the selected service is managed OpenBao, provision or retrieve its deterministic tenant-and-tuple key before validating and publishing the profile. Other providers retain their configured custody flow.
managed_key_rule: Accept an existing managed key only when its live public key and status match the requested algorithm and purpose. KMS failure must not create an active profile.
public_response_rule: Create, resolve, and DID-mediated sign responses contain identity and public signing metadata but no KMS endpoint, token, service ID, or key reference.
acceptance_cases: fresh managed profile create then resolve then DID-mediated sign without caller KMS locator
managed KMS failure leaves no active profile
cross-tenant identity cannot select another tenant key
